headline: Saudi oil pipeline hit in strikes will be mostly out of service for several weeks for repair

evidence.dominant_driver: The newly reported 3-5 week repair timeline turns a known Saudi pipeline shutdown into a more persistent physical oil-supply constraint, reinforcing inflation and risk-off pressure.

market_expectations.expected_value: Saudi East-West pipeline largely offline for 3-5 weeks with possible partial operation during repairs
market_expectations.distribution_notes: The outage itself was already known; the new information is the multi-week duration and limited partial-operation possibility.

absorption.reason: The pipeline shutdown and broader Middle East supply risk were already in prices before the AP repair-duration update. Oil had already surged above $108 Brent and equities were risk-off; the forecast therefore targets only residual movement from the decision time.

observed_reaction.gold: about -1.8% to $4,271.59 in Reuters reporting despite geopolitical risk

observations.US2Y: around 4.63% in latest available contemporaneous context, elevated
observations.VIX: around 18.1 in latest available intraday context, elevated/risk-off
observations.equities: Nasdaq and broader risk assets lower
observations.gold: falling despite geopolitical risk, showing the rates/USD channel is currently offsetting safe-haven demand

evidence.decision_notes: The update is materially new because it adds a 3-5 week repair horizon, but it arrives after a large oil/rates/equity reaction. M2 therefore treats it as a persistent supply-shock confirmation rather than a fresh unpriced shock. Leakage-safe v2 learning was reviewed; no candidate-specific ACTIONABLE model-2 evidence segment was used to alter confidence materially.

immediate.rationale: The multi-week repair timeline reinforces an already-active oil/inflation shock, but much of the first reaction is already priced.

next_session.rationale: Persistent supply constraints remain a headwind if oil stays above the pre-update range, though new policy/geopolitical headlines can dominate.

15m.rationale: Oil and yields remain elevated and cross-asset risk-off confirmation is intact.

1h.rationale: A 3-5 week repair horizon supports continued inflation-risk repricing, but the edge is moderated by partial absorption.

4h.rationale: The initial selloff is already extended and intraday dip-buying or oil stabilization can offset the headline.

next_session.rationale: The persistent physical supply constraint remains a macro headwind unless repair progress or de-escalation improves.

predictions.mechanism: A prolonged Saudi export-bypass outage sustains oil inflation, hawkish rate pricing and risk-off pressure on broad equities.
predictions.invalidation: Brent/WTI reverse sharply lower or Saudi Arabia restores most pipeline capacity materially sooner than 3-5 weeks.
predictions.counter_case: The outage duration may already be largely priced after the oil spike, allowing equities to rebound if yields retreat or partial pipeline operations resume quickly.

immediate.rationale: The oil-driven inflation shock keeps Treasury yields high and adds pressure to long-duration technology valuations.

next_session.rationale: Tech already sold off materially, so fresh AI/Fed headlines may dominate by the next session.

15m.rationale: High oil and yields remain directly adverse to duration-sensitive tech while risk sentiment is weak.

1h.rationale: Persistent supply-shock confirmation supports continued pressure, though the move is partly priced.

4h.rationale: Nasdaq is already down materially, increasing rebound risk even while macro conditions remain bearish.

next_session.rationale: Fresh Fed and AI-sector information is likely to dominate over this incremental pipeline update.

predictions.mechanism: Oil-driven inflation and high yields raise discount rates and reduce risk appetite for technology stocks.
predictions.invalidation: Oil and Treasury yields fall materially or strong tech-specific buying reverses the risk-off tape.
predictions.counter_case: An extended intraday selloff can trigger aggressive dip-buying if yields stop rising, especially because the pipeline outage itself was already known.

immediate.rationale: Europe remains vulnerable to persistent energy-price inflation and higher-rate expectations.

next_session.rationale: A multi-week supply disruption keeps the European energy/inflation backdrop unfavorable if oil remains elevated.

15m.rationale: The persistent oil shock remains a direct macro headwind for German equities.

1h.rationale: The repair timeline confirms that the supply constraint is not a one-day disturbance.

4h.rationale: European markets have already absorbed much of the oil/rates shock and may stabilize intraday.

next_session.rationale: Persistent high energy costs remain a negative carry into the next session.

predictions.mechanism: High oil raises European input costs and inflation expectations while supporting tighter monetary-policy pricing.
predictions.invalidation: Oil retraces sharply or partial Saudi pipeline operations materially reduce the expected supply loss.
predictions.counter_case: Energy shares and a stabilization in yields could cushion the DAX if the outage duration is already fully discounted.

immediate.rationale: The new multi-week repair estimate reinforces the European energy-inflation headwind.

next_session.rationale: Persistent oil stress is likely to remain a drag unless supply-route risk improves.

1h.rationale: The duration update supports continued risk-off pressure after the known shutdown.

4h.rationale: Partial absorption and sector rotation can reduce directional follow-through.

next_session.rationale: A multi-week energy supply constraint remains a macro negative into the next session.

predictions.mechanism: Persistent elevated oil prices increase inflation and margin pressure across euro-area equities.
predictions.invalidation: Oil falls sharply or Saudi export capacity returns materially faster than reported.
predictions.counter_case: The market may have already discounted much of the outage, while energy-sector gains can offset weakness elsewhere.

immediate.rationale: Geopolitical support conflicts with a strong USD/high-yield regime that has already pushed gold sharply lower.

next_session.rationale: Safe-haven demand and hawkish rate pressure remain in direct conflict.

15m.rationale: The supply-risk headline is supportive, but current price action shows rates/USD are dominating.

1h.rationale: Gold is already down about 1.8%, so chasing either direction after this delayed update has weak residual edge.

4h.rationale: Safe-haven demand could re-emerge if geopolitical risk escalates, while high yields remain bearish.

next_session.rationale: The next move depends more on Fed/yield dynamics and fresh escalation than on this repair-duration update.

predictions.mechanism: Geopolitical safe-haven demand is offset by rising oil-driven inflation expectations, stronger Fed-hike pricing and elevated real-rate proxies.
predictions.invalidation: A decisive break in either the rates/USD channel or geopolitical escalation would end the mixed regime.
predictions.counter_case: A new attack on Saudi infrastructure or shipping could rapidly revive safe-haven buying and push gold higher despite yields.
